description: This file defines a helper class 'text' for various text processing tasks such as whitespace normalization, string escaping for HTML/JavaScript/XML, and CSS compression within the KCFinder project.

classes.name: text
classes.description: A helper class providing static methods for text processing tasks including whitespace management, escaping for HTML/JavaScript/XML, and CSS compression.

methods.name: clearWhitespaces
methods.description: Replaces repeated whitespace characters in a string with a single space.

methods.name: htmlValue
methods.description: Escapes double quotes in a string for safe HTML attribute usage.

methods.name: jsValue
methods.description: Escapes quotes and newlines in a string for safe JavaScript string embedding.

methods.name: xmlData
methods.description: Prepares a string for XML CDATA sections, optionally wrapping it in CDATA.

methods.name: compressCSS
methods.description: Minifies CSS code by removing unnecessary spaces and certain characters.
